teaching.title: Programming Tutoring
bullets: Prepared practice questions on functions, lists, and arrays for use in individual programming tutoring sessions.
Asked learners to explain the steps in their solutions during individual programming tutoring sessions.

projects.title: Finite-State Machine Simulator
bullets: Translated discrete mathematical definitions into Python functions for a finite-state machine simulator in an individual course project.
Constructed examples and counterexamples for the represented rules and tested the implementation against hand-worked cases.

projects.title: Local Book Search Interface
bullets: Contributed to a team project by building a local book search interface with form inputs using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
Documented the interface and its local data flow, and tested keyboard interaction and alternate input cases.

projects.title: Book Lending Records
bullets: Designed related tables and key constraints for book lending records using SQL and SQLite in an individual course project.
Checked missing values and duplicate records, and wrote queries joining and aggregating sample book lending records.
